items.text: Former leader of Kosovo Hashim Thaçi is sentenced to twenty-five years in prison for war crimes during his leadership of the Kosovo Liberation Army.
In Turkey, hundreds of people are arrested in a crackdown on LGBTQ expression and subsequent protests.
A ferry sinks in the Java Sea, resulting in at least nine deaths and more than a hundred others missing.
A ferry fire off Coron, Palawan, Philippines, kills at least seventy-seven people.
